extraction.name: Chemex 60g/L Half Liter
extraction.short_description: Commentary-heavy Chemex transcript with filter-weight trivia
extraction.preparation: Quick aside on filters -- a Chemex filter is noticeably heavier than a normal V60 filter, it actually weighs about 4.5 grams dry versus around 1.5 grams for a Hario paper, which is part of why the Chemex cup comes out so clean. Fold the filter, rinse it with hot water, and dose in 30 grams of coffee.

steps.raw_text: Quick aside on filters -- a Chemex filter is noticeably heavier than a normal V60 filter, it actually weighs about 4.5 grams dry versus around 1.5 grams for a Hario paper, which is part of why the Chemex cup comes out so clean. Fold the filter, rinse it with hot water, and dose in 30 grams of coffee.
In terms of the bloom, do exactly as the V60: 60 to 90 grams of bloom water, and let that bloom for at least 45 seconds.

Once the bloom settles, start pouring in slow concentric circles, pretty controlled, maybe 3 grams a second, avoiding the filter walls, until you reach the full 500 grams. You're gonna have four to five minute brew times brewing half a liter with the Chemex.
At the end, give it a little stir and a swirl to help the drawdown and keep a flat bed, then just let it finish draining completely.
